login.title: Sign in
login.failed: Sign-in failed — please check your email and password.

register.title: Register
register.emailExists: This email address is already registered.
register.emailNotAllowed: This email address is not allowed (e.g. a disposable or free-mail address).
register.closedText: New sign-ups are currently disabled. Please check back later.
register.maintenanceText: We're in maintenance mode right now, so new sign-ups are paused. Please try again later.
register.inviteOnlyText: {brand} is only welcoming new members by invitation right now. If you already have an invitation, just sign in.
register.termsLabel: I accept the Terms and Conditions
register.termsDraftNotice: Draft, under review by our lawyers — the binding version will replace it after the review. We record which version you agreed to.
register.businessLabel: I am acting as a business or self-employed person, not as a consumer
register.businessNotice: Our offer is intended for businesses and self-employed people only — that is why we ask.
register.invitedEmailNote: This address is fixed: the invitation was sent to it.

oauth.privacy: Google learns that you sign in here, and we receive your name and email address. Nothing more: no ad tracking, no contacts, no access to your Google account.
oauth.oauth_unavailable: Signing in with the external provider did not work. Please sign in with email and password.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: We will send you a link to reset it.
forgot.success: If an account with this email exists, the email is on its way — check your inbox.

reset.title: New password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.invalidLink: This link is invalid — request a new one.
reset.failed: Reset failed — the link may have expired.

auth.networkError: Server unreachable — please try again later.

botCheck.required: Please confirm that you are not a robot.
botCheck.failed: The robot check failed, please try again.
botCheck.unavailable: The robot check is unavailable right now, please try again in a few minutes.

auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
auth.rateLimitedIn: Too many attempts. Wait one more second, then try again. | Too many attempts. Wait {n} more seconds, then try again.

verification.bannerMessage: We sent you a confirmation link. We can only email you once your address is confirmed.
verification.sentDescription: Check your inbox (and your spam folder).
verification.sendFailed: Sending failed — please try again later.
verification.sendFailedDescription: Check your connection and try again in a few minutes.
verification.successMessage: Thanks! Your address is now verified.
verification.invalidMessage: Request a new confirmation link here.
verification.invalidMessageGuest: Sign in, then you can request a new confirmation link.
verification.requiredMessage: This address ({email}) is not confirmed yet. Open the link in our confirmation email, then come back here.

otp.title: Sign in with code
otp.description: We will send you a 6-digit code — no password needed.
otp.codeDescription: Enter the code we sent to {email}.
otp.requestFailed: Could not request a code — please try again.
otp.unavailable: Signing in with a code isn't available here right now. Please sign in with your password or reset it.
otp.invalidCode: The code is wrong or expired — please try again.
otp.phraseHint: Your security phrase (also shown in the email):
otp.switchToOtp: Sign in without password (code via email)
otp.registerDescription: Enter your email, type the code — your account is created automatically.

auth.logoutErrorDescription: Your session may still be active. Check your connection and try again.
auth.sessionRevoked: Your session was ended — please sign in again.
auth.sessionRevokedDescription: This happens when you signed out on another device or an administrator ended the session.

challenge.title: Two-factor confirmation
challenge.description: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
challenge.recoveryDescription: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.
challenge.failed: That code is not right. Please try again.
challenge.useTotp: Use the code from your app

validation.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address
validation.passwordMin: The password must be at least 8 characters long
validation.passwordComplexity: At least 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 number and 1 special character
validation.nameMin: The name must be at least 2 characters long
validation.nameMax: The name must be at most 80 characters long
validation.nameNoLinks: The name must not contain links, addresses or line breaks
validation.bioMax: The bio must be at most 500 characters long
validation.phoneFormat: Enter the number in international format, e.g. +14155552671 (start with +, max 15 digits, no spaces)
validation.termsRequired: Please accept the Terms and Conditions
validation.businessRequired: Please confirm that you are acting as a business or self-employed person

empty.noResultsText: Nothing matches your filters right now.

consent.title: Cookie consent
consent.message: We use cookies for anonymous usage statistics. Analytics only loads after your consent.

profile.saveFailedDescription: Your changes were not applied. Check your connection and try again.
profile.phoneDescription: Optional. International format (e.g. +14155552671). Saved to your account.
profile.phoneTaken: This phone number is already in use by another account.
profile.phoneTakenDescription: Enter a different number or leave the field empty — your other changes were not saved either.
profile.photoHint: Drag & drop or click. JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB.
profile.photoTooLarge: Image is too large — max 5 MB.
profile.photoTooLargeDescription: The selection was cleared. Pick a smaller image.
profile.photoUploadFailed: Photo upload failed — please try again.
profile.photoUploadFailedDescription: Your profile was not saved. Try again, or save without a new photo for now.
profile.locationDisclosure: Optional — shown to members of your communities on the member map.

handle.title: Your name for mentions
handle.description: This is how others can mention you in posts. It belongs to your account and applies across all your communities.
handle.label: Handle
handle.hint: {min}–{max} characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
handle.lockedUntil: You can change your name every {days} days — next time on {date}.

errors.charset: Only lowercase letters, digits and underscores are allowed — not at the start or end.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Devices and browsers currently signed in to your account.
sessions.signedOutAllDescription: Every device was signed out — including this one.
sessions.signOutFailed: Could not sign out — please try again.
sessions.signOutFailedDescription: The session is still active. Reload the page and try again.
sessions.confirmAllText: This ends every session, including this one — you will be signed out.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Confirm your current password before setting a new one.
password.successDescription: Other devices were signed out; you stay signed in here.
password.failed: Password change failed — is the current password correct?

export.title: Export your data
export.description: Download a JSON copy of your account, sessions and comments.
export.successDescription: The file my-data.json is now in your downloads folder.
export.failedDescription: No file was downloaded. Check your connection and try again.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: No longer want to use your account? You can delete it here. This action is not reversible — all related data will be permanently removed.
delete.confirmText: Your account and all related data will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.failedDescription: Your account is unchanged — nothing was deleted. Try again in a moment.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor
twoFactor.description: A code from your authenticator app, on top of your password. Applies to password sign-in — when you sign in with Google, Google verifies your factors and your Pukalani code is not requested.
twoFactor.scanHint: Scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.manualHint: No scanner at hand? Enter this secret manually:
twoFactor.invalidCode: That code is not right. Please try again.
twoFactor.setupFailed: Setup did not work. Please try again.
twoFactor.codesWarning: Write them down somewhere safe now. They are shown this one time only and are your way back in if you lose your phone.
twoFactor.codesConfirm: I have written the codes down.
twoFactor.disableHint: Enter the current code from your authenticator app to confirm.
twoFactor.disableRecoveryHint: Enter one of your recovery codes to confirm.
twoFactor.disableFailed: Turning it off did not work. Please try again.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: Sets the time zone used to display dates and times.
timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.help: Automatic uses the time zone of your device.

email.title: Email notifications
email.description: Also receive bell notifications (replies, mentions, reminders) by email.
email.offDesc: Notifications only appear in the bell.
email.instantDesc: Each notification as a separate email, as soon as it happens.
email.digestDesc: At most one summary email per day with all new unread notifications.
email.saveFailedDescription: Your previous setting still applies. Check your connection and try again.
email.noSmtp: Email delivery is not configured on this server — your choice is saved and takes effect once SMTP is set up.

error.unknownHost: This address does not belong to any community.
error.communitySuspended: This community is read-only right now
error.communitySuspendedHint: New contributions are paused for the moment. The people who run this community have been notified — it will continue once that is sorted out. Your text is still here.

demo.banner: This is a demo community with sample content.

translation.unavailableHint: Automatic translation is not set up here.
translation.rateLimitedHint: Please try again in a few minutes.
translation.dailyLimitHint: You have translated a lot today. It continues tomorrow.
translation.sameLanguageHint: This text is already written in your language.
